title: CLAUDE.md's command list is missing the raided-square tools
tier_reason: A documentation gap in the file every session reads first; the tool exists and is green, it just is not listed where the others are.
ask:
CLAUDE.md's Commands section lists every capture_* scene and gen_* script with the command that runs it. Three added on 2026-09-19 for Q-110 are missing from it, because another session was holding uncommitted edits to CLAUDE.md at the time and the rule was to commit only my own files. Add a block beside the other capture entries:

# The stripped stage each crop leaves when a bird empties its square (Q-110 b) — the
# pictures are editable grids of letters in the script itself
python3 tools/gen_stripped_crops.py

# A raided square on the running farm, photographed and then checked against the turned
# soil beside it: identical pixels fail, which is the check that would have caught the
# four days the mark was invisible. Needs a display, like the visual regression.
godot --path . res://tools/capture_ransack_mark.tscn

# The Q-110 comparison boards, from plates already in the repo (no display needed)
python3 tools/compose_ransack_candidates.py

Nothing else changes. Verify CLAUDE.md still reads cleanly around the insertion.
first_action: Open CLAUDE.md's Commands section and find the capture_overnight_plates block, which is the closest match in shape (a capture that needs a display plus a compose step that does not).
source_message: Left open by the 2026-09-19 Q-110 session, which could not touch CLAUDE.md without sweeping up another session's in-flight edits. Rewritten the same night after the ruling landed: the two candidate-capture tools it originally named were deleted when the designer picked, and these three replaced them.
